name: PBK Brain Grade Readiness
purpose: Runtime truth about whether player/team/availability/matchup grades are implemented, populated, proxy-limited, validation-ready, or validated. Governance only: never changes betting eligibility, probability, EV, stake, or the forward journal.
global_guardrails: A metric with zero production evidence rows cannot be called operationally ready.
A calculated metric is not validated until predictive value is tested out of sample.
Missing player, team, lineup, availability or style evidence remains unknown; never fabricate or backfill it.
Player Form windows must use only evidence known before target kickoff.
A player missing from the starting XI is not automatically absent, injured or suspended.
Return requires an explicit observed absence-to-presence transition; missing observations do not create a return event.
Formation alone is context, not a team style or Matchup Grade feature.
Directional matchup components remain independent until each component is separately validated.
Team component grades remain independent until each component is separately validated.
Do not create Team Overall or Matchup Overall by arbitrary averaging or hand-written weights.

No player/team/availability/matchup research metric may mutate canonical R1/R2/R3 eligibility, stake, probability or the immutable forward journal before explicit validation and project-owner approval.

metrics.reason: PBK Overall Grade implementation exists, but Stage77 production player-grade coverage is not yet sufficient for validation.
metrics.next_gate: Capture real prior-match player rows, then test stability/calibration by position and predictive contribution out of sample.

metrics.reason: Provider-free retrospective walk-forward Form-3/Form-5/Form-10 research is now populated with explicit season provenance and zero detected chronology leakage. Current evidence is scope-limited, concentrated in 2025 and six PBK16 domestic leagues, with Norway dominating the sample; predictive contribution is not yet validated.
metrics.next_gate: Validate Form-3/Form-5/Form-10 versus future team outcomes and market residuals out of sample, report league/season scope explicitly, and expand historical coverage before any PBK16-wide validation claim.

metrics.reason: Official/provider-current XI snapshots exist, but reliable XI quality requires sufficient pre-kickoff player-grade coverage.
metrics.next_gate: Obtain player-grade coverage for confirmed/expected XI and validate XI edge/delta prospectively.

metrics.reason: Starts-vs-no-starts research logic with minimum samples and shrinkage exists, but eligible production importance samples are not yet sufficient.
metrics.next_gate: Accumulate finished fixtures with XI and player evidence, then evaluate stability and confounding before any decision use.

metrics.reason: Official/current-vs-previous XI membership can already measure retained and changed starters, but the descriptive turnover effect has not been validated.
metrics.next_gate: Validate simple turnover descriptively by league/context without turning raw change count into a universal penalty.

metrics.reason: Provider-free research foundation now compares current and previous official XI membership, grade coverage, XI quality and quality delta. It deliberately emits no rotation impact score. Production use is blocked by player-grade coverage and lack of out-of-sample validation.
metrics.next_gate: Populate pre-kickoff XI grades and test whether quality delta adds predictive value beyond market price, team strength and raw rotation count.

metrics.reason: Provider-free absence foundation now requires explicit no-lookahead ABSENT evidence and exposes player importance, player grade, replacement grade and replacement-quality gap as separate research components. It refuses to infer absence from a missing XI spot and does not create an arbitrary total impact score.
metrics.next_gate: Create a durable explicit availability-event ledger with source/timestamp provenance, populate importance/replacement evidence, then validate component contribution out of sample.

metrics.reason: Return-event foundation now requires an explicit observed ABSENT-to-PRESENT/STARTER/BENCH transition. Missing lineup observations or a player reappearing after an unknown gap do not create a return event. No return-impact score is authorized yet.
metrics.next_gate: Populate longitudinal availability evidence and validate whether evidence-backed returns add predictive value after controlling for player grade, importance, market price and team strength.

metrics.reason: Governed Team Component Vector exists for Attack, Defence, Form, Home, Away, Schedule/Fatigue, Squad, XI Quality, Availability, Motivation and Market. Research candidate grades stay separate and official grades require component-specific validation.
metrics.next_gate: Populate player/XI/availability evidence and validate each team component independently against future outcomes and market residuals before any component receives official-grade authority.

metrics.reason: There is no validated composite Team Overall Grade. Team component grades intentionally remain separate until incremental predictive value and a weighting method are validated.
metrics.next_gate: Validate component features first; do not create an arbitrary weighted average.

metrics.reason: Provider-free style-vs-style foundation now represents explicit pre-kickoff style dimensions and directional matchup components. Formation is context only, missing evidence remains unknown, and no overall Matchup Grade, winner, signal or probability adjustment is authorized.
metrics.next_gate: Build durable pre-kickoff style evidence from event/context sources, then validate each directional component out of sample against future outcomes and market residuals before considering any composite Matchup Grade.
